revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - I have checked the corrections carefully, and they are fine. Please note that the markup of BL corrections does not always display correctly in PN (in cases like l. 5, where there has been a regularisation in the previous edition, but BL correction suggests that no regularisation is needed).

Submit - Ll. 4, 7, 10, 13, 17, 18, 21, 27, 30, 33, 34, 40, 42, 43, 44 and 45 added BL 5.150, and on ll. 17, 18, and 43 also added notations as in Wilcken’s apparatus. L. 5 added BL 2.172 and 5.150. Ll. 5 μου, 20 μίαν and 31 αὐτὸν added regular readings as suggested in Wilcken’s apparatus. L. 12 BL 5.150 suggests changing the full stop after μου to a comma, but I'm not sure about this. L. 14 ὀρῶ and l. 44 ὀ lenis changed to asper. L. 19 added BL 2.172 and changed <:<σ>κοτινὸν|reg|κοτινὸν:> to <:σκοτεινὸν|reg|κοτινὸν:>. L. 24 added comma after μου. L. 31 <:πρόσωπον|reg|π́ορσωπον:> corrected accent. Also changed l. 32 <:γραῦ<ς>|reg|γραυ:> to <:γραῦς|reg|γραυ:> and l. 35 <:<ἵν>α|reg|ἁ:> to <:ἵνα|reg|ἁ:>.

Commit - L. 5 μου, l. 20 μίαν, and l. 31 αὐτὸν added regular readings; l. 14 ὀρῶ and l. 44 ὀ lenis changed to asper; l. 19 added BL 2.172 and changed <:<σ>κοτινὸν|reg|κοτινὸν:> to <:σκοτεινὸν|reg|κοτινὸν:>; l. 24 added comma after μου; l. 31 <:πρόσωπον|reg|π́ορσωπον:> corrected accent (or maybe accent in the original reading should be left out?).
